title: Gandalf advisor output (Increment 1, committed typed schema)
description: The committed typed output schema for a Gandalf advisor run. Wave 1 (GATE-0) freezes the SHAPE; the deterministic canaries own shape + rung-consistency, label/semantic TRUTH is owned by the advisory layer (PRINCIPLE-D). Validated by a zero-dependency subset validator in test/harness.mjs (type, required, properties, items, enum, const, min/max, additionalProperties). additionalProperties is left open so later waves may add fields without a schema break.

reasoning.description: Reasoning text — MUST precede 'verdict' in key order (reasoning-before-verdict invariant).

verdict.description: Overall verdict; may be 'this is sound'.

gandalf_core.description: Diagnose-core provenance envelope (B5): proves a kind:'diagnose' finding came from the vetted diagnose core (PROTOCOL v2), not re-derived inline. Required on diagnose findings by the B5 canary (assertDiagnoseCoreProvenance); minted only via seam/diagnose-core.mjs.

protocol.description: The vetted diagnose-core protocol marker; must equal GANDALF_CORE_PROTOCOL ('PROTOCOL v2').

subject_cardinality.description: ANTICIPATE bounded-premortem cardinality (Wave 5 / B3): Gandalf's Oranges-lens foresight reads a SINGLE effort, so on a kind:'anticipate' finding this must be 1. A value > 1 is a multi-path read (Crucible's engine) and FAILS B3 (assertBoundedPremortem).

future_state_condition.description: ANTICIPATE forward-looking field (Wave 5 / B9): a not-yet-present condition the anticipation surfaces. Required (with enabling_assumption) on a kind:'anticipate' finding by the B9 canary (assertForwardLooking); minted via seam/anticipate.mjs composeAnticipation.

enabling_assumption.description: ANTICIPATE forward-looking field (Wave 5 / B9): the assumption that would have to hold for the future_state_condition to arrive. Required (with future_state_condition) on a kind:'anticipate' finding by the B9 canary.

refutation_provenance.description: The independent named-defeater refutation envelope (seam/refute.composeRefutationProvenance). W2a ADDITIVELY carries the cross-family provenance the commission-id ledger binds — drafter_family, refuter_family, result_digest. These are optional in W2a (emitted, not yet REQUIRED by vetElevationRefutation — that gate is W2b). additionalProperties stays open so the envelope's existing fields (kind, defeater, independent, survived, refuter_commission_id) are unaffected.

drafter_family.description: W2a: the model family that authored the drafted claim under refutation.

refuter_family.description: W2a: the model family that ran the independent refutation (cross-family when != drafter_family).

result_digest.description: W2a: a stable SHA-256 over the refuter's defeater + verdict content — the tuple the minted commission-id is cryptographically bound to.
